texto_fuente: World English Bible, Catholic Edition (public domain), original text
frase_clave: So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down
reflexion: Don't let busyness and worries weigh down your heart. Take a moment today to pray and rest in the Lord: where is your focus set?

escenas.descripcion: Jesus sits outdoors among his disciples at twilight, gesturing gently as he warns them to guard their hearts.
A cozy interior room illuminated by lit oil lamps, conveying watchful expectation and peaceful waiting in the darkness.
Jesus kneels in prayer on a quiet hill at sunrise, surrounded by warm golden light in an atmosphere of serene trust.

titulo: A reading from the holy Gospel according to Luke.
texto_evangelio: At that time, “So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day will come on you suddenly. For it will come like a snare on all those who dwell on the surface of all the earth. Therefore be watchful all the time, praying that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will happen, and to stand before the Son of Man.”

fragmentos.texto: A reading from the holy Gospel according to Luke.

praying that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will happen, and to stand before the Son of Man.”

frase_es: Velad, pues, orando en todo tiempo
reflexion_es: No permitas que las prisas y las preocupaciones apaguen tu corazón. Dedica hoy un momento a la oración para descansar en el Señor: ¿dónde tienes puesta tu mirada?
